description: Experimental anchor: drug-like neutral molecules with a measured pKa ladder, completeness gates, experimental pH-7.4 dominant charge and method charges
row_grain: per-molecule (one row per drug-like neutral molecule with a measured, typed pKa ladder; molecules are keyed by the first InChIKey block)

columns.name: mol_id
columns.description: running id A0001.. in order of InChIKey skeleton

columns.name: smiles
columns.description: largest fragment, neutralised, RDKit canonical SMILES (the structure all methods were run on)

columns.name: inchikey
columns.description: standard InChIKey of smiles

columns.name: ik_skeleton
columns.description: first block of the InChIKey (14 characters), the key used for de-duplication and for merging sources

columns.name: source
columns.description: source whose constants are used: IUPAC, SAMPL or ChEMBL (priority order of the config)

columns.name: sources_also
columns.description: other sources that also hold a usable ladder of this molecule, separated by |

columns.name: sources_concordant
columns.description: True/False when sources_also is non-empty: the other sources give the same experimental dominant charge; empty otherwise

columns.name: mw
columns.description: molecular weight of smiles

columns.name: heavy_atoms
columns.description: heavy-atom count of smiles

columns.name: n_sites_dd
columns.description: Dimorphite SMARTS ionisable groups with table-mean pKa inside the gate window (N-C-N-linked sites counted once)

columns.name: n_sites_ind
columns.description: independent-SMARTS ionisable groups whose nominal pKa range overlaps the gate window (N-C-N-linked sites counted once)

columns.name: n_sites_pred
columns.description: max(n_sites_dd, n_sites_ind): predicted ionisable sites required by the strict completeness gate

columns.name: n_sites_rel
columns.description: max over the two SMARTS sets of the sites predicted within pH 7.4 +/- relevant_halfwidth: requirement of the relaxed gate

columns.name: n_pka_exp
columns.description: macroscopic constants of the molecule after merging replicates

columns.name: n_pka_exp_window
columns.description: of these, constants inside the gate window (pH 2-12)

columns.name: n_pka_exp_relevant
columns.description: of these, constants within pH 7.4 +/- relevant_halfwidth

columns.name: complete_profile
columns.description: strict gate: True if n_pka_exp_window >= n_sites_pred, no constant was dropped for dispersion and the ladder has no gap

columns.name: complete_relaxed
columns.description: relaxed gate (superset of complete_profile): complete_profile, or n_pka_exp_relevant >= n_sites_rel with no dropped constant and no ladder gap

columns.name: had_dropped_constant
columns.description: True if a constant of this molecule was dropped because its replicate measurements spread by more than the dispersion limit

columns.name: ladder_gap
columns.description: True if the step numbers of a direction are not 1..k without a gap, or the constants of a direction are not monotone in the step number

columns.name: exp_dominant_charge
columns.description: net charge of the most populated charge state at pH 7.4, independent-site Henderson-Hasselbalch on the measured constants

columns.name: exp_pop_max
columns.description: population of that charge state

columns.name: ambiguous
columns.description: True if exp_pop_max is below the ambiguity limit

columns.name: coupled_sites
columns.description: True if two adjacent measured constants inside the gate window lie closer than the coupling gap

columns.name: exp_ladder_charge
columns.description: dominant net charge from the exact macroscopic ladder (cross-check of the independent-site result)

columns.name: exp_ladder_agrees
columns.description: True if exp_ladder_charge equals exp_dominant_charge

columns.name: functional_class
columns.description: primary functional class of the independent SMARTS set (priority order of the config; none = no site)

columns.name: classes_all
columns.description: all classes with a site, separated by |

columns.name: q_naive
columns.description: net charge of the default state (min |charge| member of the pH 6.4-8.4 Dimorphite ensemble)

columns.name: q_dimorphite_dom
columns.description: net charge of the Dimorphite-DL dominant state at pH 7.4

columns.name: q_openbabel
columns.description: net charge of the OpenBabel -p 7.4 state; EMPTY when RDKit cannot sanitise the OpenBabel output (baseline convention)

columns.name: q_enum_popmax
columns.description: net charge of the most populated pH 6.4-8.4 ensemble member

columns.name: q_ml_pka
columns.description: net charge of the independent-site dominant state from MolGpKa predictions

columns.name: ml_in_molgpka_example_sdf
columns.description: True if the InChIKey skeleton occurs in the 19,848-molecule mols.sdf shipped with MolGpKa

columns.name: ml_in_pkasolver_train
columns.description: True if the InChIKey skeleton occurs in the pkasolver/Baltruschat training collection

columns.name: ml_in_chembl37
columns.description: True if the InChIKey skeleton occurs in ChEMBL 37 (upper bound of the unpublished ChEMBL-derived MolGpKa training molecules)
